title: Gingerbread Ritual
description: A woman with long green hair and a grey robe holds a gingerbread man cookie, standing at a round table covered in magical symbols. Multiple identical red and purple gingerbread figures with angry expressions are arranged in rows, some appearing to emerge from a dark smoky crater in the table, while a glowing blue cat-like creature with lightning bolts emits a bright energy burst on the right.
prompt: A mystical woman with long flowing green hair wearing a grey robe stands at a round magical table covered in arcane symbols and glowing runes. She holds a gingerbread man cookie in her hand while looking at a glowing blue starry cat creature with lightning bolts shooting out from it in a bright yellow energy burst. On the table are multiple rows of angry red and purple gingerbread men with spiral tails posing dynamically, some emerging from a dark smoky crater with scattered broken gingerbread pieces, in a surreal fantasy style with bokeh lights in the background.
